scope: XFCE-native selections retained in local tmux history
artifacts: Meson debugoptimized xfce4-terminal with private VTE

contracts.behavior: Words, OSC8 labels, detected URLs, Unicode and wrapped labels select immediately with the same boundaries as an un-multiplexed widget

Before scrolling redraws cells, a completed native selection transfers to history coordinates, remains copyable offscreen and at the live bottom, and can be replaced without moving the viewport or copying on release; line and Ctrl-drag rectangle selections preserve native newline behavior
Mouse-aware applications retain mouse input while tmux copy mode permits native selection

Dragging toward a top/bottom edge autoscrolls with a stationary pointer, preserves the fixed anchor and box orientation, and stops inward or on release without copying; horizontal edge-row selection does not scroll

environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG/session bus and Xvfb, real VTE widget, PTYs and explicit test-owned tmux sockets
environments.native_wayland: Manual desktop gesture and cross-application clipboard checks have not been run; live sessions are never test fixtures
